Autotranslate summary

The story follows "Senior," an undercover agent investigating a certain drug organization, and "me," a rookie.
"Senior" is a woman, but she is incredibly strong, cool and strict, yet deep down she is kind.
I respect her and secretly admire her as a woman.

One day, I make a mistake and get captured by a crime organization.
To save me, "Senior" agrees to their disgusting demands...
She is covered in a suspicious liquid and subjected to a brutal assault by the thugs! Tied up, I can do nothing but stand there with an erection

As my beloved "Senior" is violated right before my eyes ... I will endure. If I endure, help will surely come from headquarters. "Senior", with her strong sense of justice, will never give in no matter what happens to her--!!
n: [Manga] [Kuron] Hema Shita Boku o Kabatte Tsukamatta Senpai Onna Sousakan ga Akutou-domo ni Biyaku-zuke de Yarareru Sugata ni Kuzu Bokki
